doc.title: Flip Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 11, 1996

title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks him on behalf of Hamilton College and they wrap up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I’ll drink to that. Double. Well thanks for coming over and fitting us into your busy schedule here, and it’s been a real pleasure.
So on behalf of Hamilton College, I hope your gig goes well tonight.
It’s a wonderful college, it looks great.
Maybe we can have you up there sometime. © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
